design: Very tall broad-shouldered archivist with a flat wide cranium, curved heavy lower mandibles and pale short dreadlocks forming a low rear fan. Heavy asymmetrical charcoal robe and one stiff bronze-trimmed shoulder shawl, wide padded belt. Holds a tall rectangular engraved archive panel upright beside the body with left hand; right hand rests open on chest. Dark grey mottled hide.
